fusions.name: Swarming Lashes
fusions.desc: Lashes 5 arms out spread wide, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Ravening Bite
fusions.desc: Bites the first enemy an arm meets, dealing 8 damage and healing you for 30% of the damage dealt. It costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Cloud of Arms
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Stripped Bare
fusions.desc: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 6. When you reach 6 they all spend at once as a burst of damage. Unfed, a stack fades every 12 seconds.
